verdicts.title: Proof Complexity of Symbolic QBF Reasoning
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We introduce and investigate symbolic proof systems for Quantified Boolean Formulas (QBF) operating on Ordered Binary Decision Diagrams (OBDDs). verdicts.judge_reasoning: The abstract discusses OBDD-based symbolic QBF proof systems and path-width, with no mention of cumulative entropy Φ, elimination-order sensitivity, or max-vs-min occurrence orderings for Tseitin formulas. It shares the general theme of variable ordering but does not address the specific quantitative claim.
